Description: Assist patrons at entertainment events by performing duties, such as collecting admission tickets and passes from patrons, assisting in finding seats, searching for lost articles, and locating such facilities as rest rooms and telephones.

Occupation Name: Miscellaneous Entertainment Attendants and Related Workers
Description: Perform event-related tasks not listed under other occupations, such as carnival ride operators, costume characters, or escape room attendants.

Broad Name: Miscellaneous Entertainment Attendants and Related Workers
Description: Perform variety of attending duties at amusement or recreation facility. May schedule use of recreation facilities, maintain and provide equipment to participants of sporting events or recreational pursuits, or operate amusement concessions and rides.

Broad Name: Miscellaneous Entertainment Attendants and Related Workers
Description: Select, fit, and take care of costumes for cast members, and aid entertainers. May assist with multiple costume changes during performances.

Occupation Name: Locker Room, Coatroom, and Dressing Room Attendants
Broad Name: Miscellaneous Entertainment Attendants and Related Workers
Description: Provide personal items to patrons or customers in locker rooms, dressing rooms, or coatrooms.

Occupation Name: Entertainment Attendants and Related Workers, All Other
Broad Name: Miscellaneous Entertainment Attendants and Related Workers
Description: All entertainment attendants and related workers not listed separately.

Funeral Service Workers, includes various professionals involved in providing funeral services and supporting bereaved families. This category typically encompasses funeral directors, morticians, embalmers, and funeral attendants. Funeral service workers are responsible for assisting families in making funeral arrangements, preparing bodies for burial or cremation, organizing memorial services, and providing emotional support to grieving individuals.
Prepare bodies for burial or cremation by cleansing and preserving remains. May reconstruct disfigured bodies to restore natural appearance.
Prepare bodies for interment in conformity with legal requirements.
Assist funeral directors in various tasks, including setting up viewing rooms, arranging flowers, and transporting caskets.

Perform variety of tasks during funeral, such as placing casket in parlor or chapel prior to service; arranging floral offerings or lights around casket; directing or escorting mourners; closing casket; and issuing and storing funeral equipment.
Coordinate all aspects of funeral services, including embalming, meeting with families to plan services, and handling administrative duties such as records and permits.

Perform various tasks to arrange and direct funeral services, such as coordinating transportation of body to mortuary, interviewing family or other authorized person to arrange details, selecting pallbearers, aiding with the selection of officials for religious rites, and providing transportation for mourners.

The category of Personal Appearance Workers typically includes occupations such as hairstylists, barbers, makeup artists, skincare specialists, and nail technicians. These professionals provide personal grooming services to clients, helping them enhance their appearance.
Provide hair, makeup, and related beauty services. Cut, style, and color hair; recommend products; and maintain sanitary work areas.
Provide barbering services, such as cutting, trimming, shampooing, and styling hair, trimming beards, or giving shaves.

Provide beauty services, such as shampooing, cutting, coloring, and styling hair, and massaging and treating scalp. May apply makeup, dress wigs, perform hair removal, and provide nail and skin care services.
Offer specialized beauty or grooming services not classified under standard roles, potentially including skincare, nail, or spa treatments.
Apply makeup to performers to reflect period, setting, and situation of their role.
Clean and shape customers' fingernails and toenails. May polish or decorate nails.
Shampoo and rinse customers' hair.
Provide skincare treatments to face and body to enhance an individual's appearance. Includes electrologists and laser hair removal specialists.

The category of Baggage Porters, Bellhops, and Concierges includes occupations that are involved in providing assistance and services to guests in hotels, resorts, and other hospitality establishments.
Assist hotel, resort, or travel guests by carrying luggage, providing information, making reservations, and handling other customer-service tasks.
Handle baggage for travelers at transportation terminals or for guests at hotels or similar establishments.

Assist patrons at hotel, apartment, or office building with personal services. May take messages, arrange or give advice on transportation, business services or entertainment, or monitor guest requests for housekeeping and maintenance.

Tour and Travel Guides are professionals who provide guided tours and travel services to individuals or groups visiting various destinations. They provide information about the history, culture, landmarks, and other relevant details of the places being visited.
Escort individuals or groups on sightseeing tours or through places of interest. Provide historical, cultural, or practical information to enhance the visitor experience.
Escort individuals or groups on sightseeing tours or through places of interest, such as industrial establishments, public buildings, and art galleries.
Plan, organize, and conduct long distance travel, tours, and expeditions for individuals and groups.

Occupation Name: Other Personal Care and Service Workers
Description: The category of 39-9000 Other Personal Care and Service Workers includes a diverse range of occupations that provide personal care and support services to individuals in various settings. These workers typically assist clients with their daily living activities, promote their well-being, and provide companionship. The category encompasses a wide array of roles, including personal care aides, residential advisors, child and youth workers, recreation workers, and personal trainers. These workers often have direct and regular contact with clients, offering assistance and support in areas such as grooming, hygiene, mobility, meal preparation, and household tasks.

Minor Name: Other Personal Care and Service Workers
Description: Attend to children’s basic needs, plan activities, and monitor their safety. May help with homework and implement schedules for meals or playtime.

Minor Name: Other Personal Care and Service Workers
Description: Attend to children at schools, businesses, private households, and childcare institutions. Perform a variety of tasks, such as dressing, feeding, bathing, and overseeing play.

Minor Name: Other Personal Care and Service Workers
Description: Care for children in private households and provide support and expertise to parents in satisfying children's physical, emotional, intellectual, and social needs. Duties may include meal planning and preparation, laundry and clothing care, organization of play activities and outings, discipline, intellectual stimulation, language activities, and transportation.

Minor Name: Other Personal Care and Service Workers
Description: Assist individuals with daily living activities at home or in care facilities. Duties often include housekeeping, meal preparation, and companionship.

Minor Name: Other Personal Care and Service Workers
Description: Assist the elderly, convalescents, or persons with disabilities with daily living activities at the person's home or in a care facility. Duties performed at a place of residence may include keeping house (making beds, doing laundry, washing dishes) and preparing meals. May provide assistance at non-residential care facilities. May advise families, the elderly, convalescents, and persons with disabilities regarding such things as nutrition, cleanliness, and household activities.

Minor Name: Other Personal Care and Service Workers
Description: Lead leisure or fitness activities in settings such as parks, recreation facilities, gyms, or community centers. Develop exercise programs and motivate participants.

Minor Name: Other Personal Care and Service Workers
Description: Instruct or coach groups or individuals in exercise activities. Demonstrate techniques and form, observe participants, and explain to them corrective measures necessary to improve their skills.

Minor Name: Other Personal Care and Service Workers
Description: Conduct recreation activities with groups in public, private, or volunteer agencies or recreation facilities. Organize and promote activities, such as arts and crafts, sports, games, music, dramatics, social recreation, camping, and hobbies, taking into account the needs and interests of individual members.

Minor Name: Other Personal Care and Service Workers
Description: Supervise students or residents in group housing facilities, enforcing rules and coordinating social or educational activities.

Minor Name: Other Personal Care and Service Workers
Description: Coordinate activities in residential facilities in secondary and college dormitories, group homes, or similar establishments. Order supplies and determine need for maintenance, repairs, and furnishings. May maintain household records and assign rooms. May assist residents with problem solving or refer them to counseling resources.

Occupation Name: Miscellaneous Personal Care and Service Workers
Minor Name: Other Personal Care and Service Workers
Description: Deliver personal care or support services not covered by other roles, e.g., valet parking, spa attendants, or personal organizers.

Occupation Name: Personal Care and Service Workers, All Other
Minor Name: Other Personal Care and Service Workers
Broad Name: Miscellaneous Personal Care and Service Workers
Description: All personal care and service workers not listed separately.

Focuses on selling goods or services directly to consumers or other businesses. Occupations range from retail sales associates to wholesale sales representatives, often involving customer service and product promotion.

Supervisors of Sales Workers are responsible for overseeing and managing the activities of sales teams within various industries. They play a crucial role in providing guidance, training, and support to sales personnel, monitoring sales performance, and implementing strategies to achieve sales targets.
Direct and coordinate sales staff activities. Assign tasks, train employees, set sales goals, and monitor performance.

Occupation Name: First-Line Supervisors of Retail Sales Workers
Description: Directly supervise and coordinate activities of retail sales workers in an establishment or department. Duties may include management functions, such as purchasing, budgeting, accounting, and personnel work, in addition to supervisory duties.

Occupation Name: First-Line Supervisors of Non-Retail Sales Workers
Description: Directly supervise and coordinate activities of sales workers other than retail sales workers. May perform duties such as budgeting, accounting, and personnel work, in addition to supervisory duties.

Retail Sales Workers are individuals who work in various retail settings, such as department stores, boutiques, and online marketplaces. They are responsible for assisting customers, providing product information, processing sales transactions, and ensuring a positive shopping experience.
Handle customer purchases, operate cash registers or other point-of-sale equipment, process payments, and may bag or wrap merchandise.

Receive and disburse money in establishments other than financial institutions. May use electronic scanners, cash registers, or related equipment. May process credit or debit card transactions and validate checks.
